reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
), paired AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur,
    LAG(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_spend_eur
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT channel_id, month, spend_eur, prev_spend_eur
FROM paired
WHERE spend_eur < prev_spend_eur

  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
), paired AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend
  SELECT m.channel_id, m.month, m.spend_eur,
    (SELECT MAX(m2.month) FROM monthly m2 WHERE m2.channel_id = m.channel_id AND m2.month < m.month) AS prev_month
  FROM monthly m
)
SELECT p.channel_id, p.month, p.spend_eur, b.spend_eur AS prev_spend_eur
FROM paired p
JOIN monthly b ON b.channel_id = p.channel_id AND b.month = p.prev_month
WHERE p.spend_eur < b.spend_eur
